Profile Engine (fdiene.com). The resume you are reading is served by an API: this site is the project.. API-first profile engine in a Bun + Turborepo monorepo: Zod schemas as the single source of truth, an Elysia API with end-to-end Eden typing, and a context-aware Astro/Vue front (?role=&lang=) that reorders the whole resume for its reader. EN/FR/DE i18n is generated offline by a schema-validated Claude pipeline. One deliberate runtime exception: a retrieval-augmented POST /ask answers real questions about this profile, grounded only in what's here, behind five layers of cost and abuse protection. Full test suite green, GitHub Actions CI, Docker image behind Traefik. The DX demonstration is the product itself.. ## Why this project exists
This resume is not a PDF: it is a running system. Every view you see is served by a typed API, and this drawer itself was fetched from `GET /v1/projects/profile-engine`.

## Architecture
- **Monorepo** Bun + Turborepo: `packages/schema` (Zod source of truth), `packages/core` (pure domain shared by API and web), `apps/api` (Elysia), `apps/web` (Astro + Vue islands).
- **End-to-end typing**: the web client consumes the API through Eden treaty types exported by the server.
- **Role-aware ordering**: tag weights plus an editorial `featured_for` boost reorder the whole resume per audience.

## Resilience and safety
- EN/FR/DE content is generated offline by a schema-validated Claude pipeline, with one deliberate, documented exception: `POST /ask` answers real questions about this profile using local embeddings, cosine similarity, and a scoped Claude call, grounded only in what's on this resume - gated behind five cost/abuse-protection layers (input validation, a free relevance pre-filter, per-IP and global rate limits, an account-level spending cap).
- If the API is unreachable, the site rebuilds the exact same view from embedded data and says so: [SYSTEM DEGRADED].
- The console JSON highlighter is escape-first and adversarially tested.

## Numbers
- Full test suite green, CI on every push, Docker image behind Traefik.

OMNIS. IT-flow governance from the ops floor: map, reconcile, prove.. IT-infrastructure flow-governance platform, piloted in an air-gapped aerospace environment: application and dependency mapping (ArchiMate), flow-conformity reconciliation between the declared repository and security rules (four-state model), deterministic rule-conflict detection and signature-based deduplication. Open-Core TypeScript monorepo with a client edition isolated by carve-out: 88 tests, configurable repository imports with anonymization. Product pivot under way toward IT-landscape governance, as an ops-first challenger to enterprise-architecture tools.

Harness. An MCP server that governs my AI agents: routing, guardrails, and token economics.. Cross-project orchestration layer built on the official MCP SDK (TypeScript, Zod): a supervisor exposes at most 3 tools per intent to keep agent context lean, an LLM router sends each task to the cheapest capable model, and guardrails enforce token budgets and require explicit confirmation before any destructive action. Per-project tool registries (JSON manifests) plug n8n automations and git sync into Claude Code and Cursor. My daily driver for agent operations, private and evolving.

SEOMNIX Empire. A content engine in production, where nothing publishes without passing judgment.. LangGraph + FastAPI content pipeline in production (Directus, n8n): research, writing, media and publishing orchestrated as a graph. Its centerpiece, now being implemented: an LLM-as-a-judge eval_node (Claude Haiku judge, Pydantic structured output) that refuses hallucinations by confronting every article with its research sources, then deterministically routes Keep / Correct / Reject before anything ships. Eval metrics persisted to Directus for observability, deterministic Evals in CI: generated content never escapes scrutiny.

ops-tools. The CLI that onboards, operates and secures my entire repo ecosystem.. Published npm CLI (@fdiene/ops-tools) that runs config-driven preflight health checks across my personal infrastructure: Docker containers on a VPS, an MCP server, .env completeness, and backlog progress, all defined in a single manifest. Dual-distributed as a zero-dependency compiled binary and an npm package, tested with Bun's native test runner, with gitleaks scanning every push in CI. A pre-publish security spike caught a real leak risk before it shipped: without an explicit files allowlist, npm pack was bundling 76 internal files (roadmap, backlog, VPS topology) through the .gitignore fallback.

ArtMap. A guided painting app for a client: color science, AI vision, and shipping discipline.. Mobile app (Expo/React Native) with a Next.js backend, designed and built end-to-end for a client: a photo becomes a numbered painting guide. Custom color engine (HEX/RGB/XYZ/LAB conversions, Delta E matching, physical paint-mixing ratios), AI image analysis with strictly parsed structured output, and privacy by design (GDPR utilities, explicit AI-training opt-in in the schema). Shipped through disciplined client QA cycles: versioned builds, acceptance scripts, ticketed regressions. Currently in client acceptance testing.

Omnis-Agri (Agri-OS). Safety-critical edge architecture for connected agriculture, designed like an aircraft system.. Design-stage edge architecture for an instrumented greenhouse (humidity/temperature/light sensors, pump and fan actuators) with one non-negotiable rule: no physical action executes without validation by a Judge Agent, a deterministic loop inspired by aerospace command chains. Conversational observability via MCP: greenhouse state queryable from Claude Desktop. Currently in design, from hardware selection to the Directus data model.

Enterprise Technical Architect - Strategic PLM/MES Engineering 4.0 Program. Safran Aircraft Engines. Owned the hybrid (cloud & on-premise) deployment architecture of the group's strategic PLM.. Secured multi-site interconnections (TCP/IP, IPsec/SSL VPN), enabling reliable diagnostics on production-critical flows.. Unified identity and access (SSO, LDAP, Kerberos, OpenID Connect, OAuth2) to group standards, shrinking the attack surface of privileged access.. Guaranteed end-to-end traceability from business need to operations through ArchiMate/TOGAF maps, accelerating architecture-board decisions.. Industrialized inter-system exchanges (REST/SOAP/GraphQL over Mulesoft, RabbitMQ) with high availability and redundancy, hardening production data flows.

Software Solutions Architect. Airbus Helicopters. Owned Enovia VPM V4 platform reliability and industrialized the software delivery chain.. Hardened the Enovia VPM V4 platform (environments, access rights, licensing, C++ customization), guaranteeing continuity for the program teams.. Industrialized the delivery chain (Gradle/Maven, Jenkins pipelines, JFrog Artifactory, Ansible automation), eliminating manual deployment errors.. Reduced incidents and hardened software quality (SonarQube, JUnit, Ranorex, EggPlant, XRay) in direct support of the H175, NH90 and AS332 programs.. Built Java services for CAD/PLM interoperability, streamlining exchanges between engineering offices.

PLM Administrator. Dassault Falcon Jet. Migrated the PLM platform to AIX 7.2 on production-critical environments.. Executed the cutover plan end to end (Enovia VPM V4 upgrade packages, data-flow supervision, post-migration validation) with no interruption for the programs.. Coordinated infrastructure and application teams, guaranteeing business continuity throughout the migration.

Full Stack Developer - PLM Neo A32X & A35X Programs. Airbus Defence and Space. Extended the Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE platform for the A32X and A35X programs.. Designed and integrated a 3DEXPERIENCE data model aligned with the client's business cases, accelerating platform adoption by the business teams.. Developed web services, widgets and JPOs, extending the platform to program-specific needs.. Raised offshore (India) and internal teams' standards through training and coaching on development best practices.

Aerospace Structures Engineer - CSeries (A220) Program. Bombardier Aerospace. Performed stress analysis on composite structures and built the supporting calculation tooling.. Designed a new SQL database for composite materials, centralizing previously scattered test data.. Built a VB.NET stress-calculation tool and optimized fatigue-test computations, accelerating test campaigns on metallic structures.
